verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de markets 'B2B bulk notarization and API integration', and its translation endpoint accepts one or multiple documents in a single request. Other documented endpoints (notarization, incorporation, tax and trade registration) create one request at a time, so bulk work elsewhere means scripting repeated API calls and tracking them via webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented batch endpoint for notarization and other operations, bulk status or management operations, documented batch limits and behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk use.
